content.validation_notes: Fasudil docking to alpha-synuclein is supported by literature (Semenyuk PI, 2022, PMID: 36232847), which predicted binding sites with good agreement with experimental data. For Ligand-47, while not specifically mentioned, the literature broadly supports molecular docking for identifying small molecule ligands and their binding sites on alpha-synuclein (e.g., Waheed ZA et al., 2025, PMID: 41234634; Hwang H et al., 2025, PMID: 41006545; Emani LS et al., 2025, PMID: 40502653; Manimaran D et al., 2025, PMID: 39850503). The user's request for '2 or not more than 3 clusters for ensemble docking' is noted for the engineering phase. No specific binding site residues were identified for PED00024_e001 in the PED entry details.
